fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.lede: Each lamp is a contract Pelita watches. The control is the same contract without Pelita, so it stays dark.
fleet.empty: The fleet appears here once the contracts are deployed.
try.title: Try it yourself
try.lede: Put the demo lamp out with one command on Base Sepolia, then watch it come back on its own.
try.pending: The command appears here once Beacon is deployed.
try.s1: Your poke makes Beacon emit a beat. Flicker reacts to every beat and pays for each reaction.
try.s2: After a few beats Flicker cannot pay. The system contract marks it dark and logs that.
try.s3: Pelita's Keeper hears the log, pays the debt and adds a refill in the same transaction.
try.s4: Flicker is lit again. Its card in the fleet links every hash of the loop.
gauge.title: Fuel gauge
gauge.lede: Paste the address of a reactive contract on Lasna. Your browser reads its fuel straight from the Lasna RPC; nothing passes through this site.
gauge.label: Contract address on Lasna

gauge.leftPending: shown once the fee series is measured
gauge.fill: Refuel it. Anyone can, no permission needed:

how.title: How it works
how.d6: On Base Sepolia: callback to the Tank
how.costPending: The cost per relight is measured on chain during the series and published in docs/measured.md.
how.l1: Testnet only: Reactive Lasna and Base Sepolia.
how.l2: Pelita pays from its own tank. When the tank runs low it stops and says so.
how.l3: A daily cap and a maximum debt per contract stop one contract from draining the tank.
how.l4: On Base Sepolia the refill travels through a callback, so it takes one step longer than on Lasna.
